implemented_locally: Audit events require exact tenant, organisation, project and environment scope, actor, policy version, target, correlation and timestamp fields.
Audit events are append-only, idempotent and hash-chained with tamper-evident digests.
Exact-scope exports use an independent per-scope hash chain and are independently verifiable from the returned events.
Secret-shaped fields are redacted before persistence.
Data classification is explicit for public, business, message, knowledge, credential, audit, billing, telemetry and evidence records.
